Elettronica designs, develops and manages systems and services and provides technical solutions in which quality and safety are combined with the highest standards in terms of innovation, reliability and operational performance. The activities of C.G.T. Electronics are based on specialized technical services for high-level performance systems that include design, hardware and software development, integration and commissioning. Systems and services have always enabled C.G.T. Electronics to collaborate with governments and government agencies, private companies and international organizations. History The C.G.T. Elettronica S.p.A. was established in 1985 by Ing. Michele Grifa, with the aim of being a company of security and telecommunications systems. The Company's first years of life are dedicated to various consultancy for electronic projects, consultancy on plants for Nuclear Power Plants, systems for the control of train traffic on the Rome-Naples, construction of small security systems. After the first phase of "incubation" that allowed the company to gain technical and commercial experience, since 1988 the company has started to create more complex sub-contracting plants on behalf of other companies, in the security and telecommunications sector. Since 1990, the decision and therefore the implementation of directly addressing the end user and expanding its sector of activity to audiovisual systems, video and audio directing banks. In the following years, precise entrepreneurial strategies lead to the direct acquisition of important orders throughout the country. subpages.text: CGT Elettronica Viterbo, 01100 Roma, 00131 Phone +39 (0)761 250537 +39 06 65793119 E-mail [email protected] Menu Home Company Mission e strategia Organizzazione Certificazioni Services Impianti elettronici Applicazioni elettroniche Informatica ed infrastrutture IT Impianti ed applicazioni elettriche maintenance Projects Electronic Applications Electronic systems Electrical installations and applications IT and IT infrastructure Maintenance Products Contacts KERBERO KX Il dispositivo kerbero è un terminale intelligente a lettura di prossimità e smartcard per singolo varco che unisce diverse tecnologie finalizzate alla implementazione di un avanzato sistema di controllo accessi e rilevamento presenze. Kerbero e’ un dispositivo in grado di leggere tessere contactless (RFID), codice da tastiera e tessere smat-card in standard ISO 7816; dotato di unità di controllo interna collegabile in rete, tastiera capacitiva per la selezione delle funzioni di base e display grafico. Estremamente affidabile costituisce una soluzione conveniente per incrementare la sicurezza di una infrastruttura. Kerbero è compatibile con la “Carta Multi-servizi della Difesa” CMD (Smart-card e RFID).
